name: esp-zigbee-dongle
description: ESP32-H2 Zigbee/ESPHome stackable motherboard and daisy-chained daughterboards, designed as code with tscircuit.

scripts.prepare: if command -v pre-commit >/dev/null 2>&1; then pre-commit install; fi
scripts.check: tsci check boards/motherboard.circuit.tsx && tsci check boards/daughters/co2-temp-hum.circuit.tsx
